gen-fs-bevellier-gf-alexandria: Bevellier cuts flat, stencil-like letters, wire-like and packed with very tight sidebearings. Alexandria, a sans with a tall body and open c terminals, gives those tight, uniform strokes some room to breathe.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Bevellier is all flat, stencil-cut strokes, with no contrast between stems and joins. It earns its place big and brief, while Anek Gurmukhi, with big open counters in every small letter, takes over the rest.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anek-kannada: Flat, stencil-cut and graceful: that is Bevellier. Anek Kannada, with terminals stopping far from the stem and a high, squared-off x-height, keeps a long run of text moving without fuss.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anek-latin: Bevellier keeps every stroke at a measured thickness, flat and stencil-like. It earns its keep big and short, leaving Anek Latin, whose lowercase rises nearly to the capitals, to carry the rest.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam is a sans whose curves never quite close. Next to Bevellier, whose stencil-cut strokes all share a single width, that open-tipped softness is the real draw here.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anek-odia: Rounds left unsealed, like an unlatched hook, keep the body light. Anek Odia lets Bevellier, flat and stencil-cut with no thick or thin parts, take the spotlight while it carries the text.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anek-tamil: Modern in spirit, Anek Tamil keeps its round bowls generous. Its sans-serif lowercase, with curves that look half unwrapped, carries a full page of text smoothly beneath graceful, stencil-cut Bevellier.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu reads openly, with wide, tall bowls setting the rhythm. Bevellier, whose stencil-cut strokes run like ribbon of constant width, leads the page gracefully while this sans takes the reading.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-anuphan: Anuphan keeps things clean, with big round bowls and open curves. Next to Bevellier, whose flat strokes hold steady pressure from first letter to last, it feels softer and more open, a gentle counterweight.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-athiti: Approachable and contemporary, Athiti leaves a visible gap in every s and holds its mean line high. And beside graceful, stencil-cut Bevellier, Athiti keeps long stretches of text easy on the eye.
